podcasts.name: Tech Snippets Today with Joseph Raczynski
podcasts.title: From Cockpits to Codebases: What Actually Makes an MVP Manager? with Matt Gjertsen
podcasts.description: Today, we are cutting straight through the corporate jargon to tackle one of the toughest transitions in anyone’s career: shifting from doing the work to leading the people who do it. My guest today is the author of Minimum Viable Manager . Matt brings an incredible frontline perspective shaped by two decades of high-stakes leadership—from flying in the U.S. Air Force to designing leadership training at SpaceX, and advising some of today’s fastest-growing tech organizations. His book skips the performative "executive presence" playbook and zeroes in on the three fundamental skills every new technical leader must master: building real trust, setting unambiguous expectations, and delivering feedback that actually sticks. We’ll dissect why so many brilliant engineers and individual contributors stumble when stepping into leadership… how high-stress environments forge resilient teams, and how these core human foundations hold up in an era increasingly disrupted by artificial intelligence and autonomous systems. Here we go.
